<p class="page-deck">A connected programme mapping the global urban climate literature and examining where research is produced, how it travels and which places remain poorly served. Public outputs include an AI-assisted evidence map of 53,295 papers and a 2026 preprint on the geographies of urban climate learning.</p>

**Status:** Active  
**Primary theme:** [Urban climate learning and evidence transfer](/research/themes/urban-climate-learning.html)  
**Related themes:** [Urban climate evidence infrastructure and decision-support tools](/research/themes/evidence-infrastructure-tools.html)

## Research questions

- What does the global urban climate evidence base cover and omit?
- How do research production and evidence access vary between cities and regions?

## Scope

- **Geography:** global
- **Governance scales:** international, municipal
- **Methods:** evidence-mapping, literature-review, machine-learning, spatial-analysis
- **Climate domains:** evidence-and-learning
- **Sectors:** cross-sectoral
